source.label: Placed in M94 as the app draws it, where the star's sight line crosses the disc's midplane: 4,337,391 pc (src/objects/m94-layers/source/recipe.json: centre 4,337,106 pc, inclination 31.77 deg, line of nodes 105 deg). The galaxy's distance, which places the galaxy and not a star within it: Tully et al. (2023), Cosmicflows-4, ApJ 944, 94; CDS J/ApJ/944/94, table 2 (distances of individual galaxies), PGC 43495: distance modulus 28.186 ± 0.039 mag (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/ApJ/944/94)

controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Color of a blackbody at the star's temperature; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The color of a blackbody at the star's published temperature. The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Reeve & Howarth (2016), MNRAS 456, 1294 compute from non-LTE TLUSTY B-star model atmospheres for the Bessell V band at 18,000 K and log g 2.15 (u1 0.290, u2 0.271): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.
